services.name: STORIED CHARLESTON BY LIZ BUTLER
services.desc: Liz Legare Butler is a tenth-generation Charlestonian, an award-winning author, a recipient of the 2020 Best of Charleston award, and has been a licensed tour guide since 2003. Her love of history, her family connection, and masterful storytelling make taking a tour with her intimate and interesting. Join Liz as she leads you on a small group tour of her favorite city. Wander down cobblestone streets admiring window boxes and ironwork. quotes.author: Angelina M. via Yelp
quotes.text: Our tour guide was well knowledgeable and very theatrical which we LOVED!! He has witty jokes and didn't walk to fast. I would recommend this tour because it's not over crowded like some of the tours in the area. You don't feel like your getting left behind and you leave having a great time! 10/10!!

quotes.author: Seana H. via Google
quotes.text: Did the ghost tour with Brian (and Robin) this week and it was a blast. They were fun, knowledgeable, and had great energy. The Unitarian churchyard is a must-see exclusive to this tour, and I got some great book recommendations too!

quotes.author: Maria K. via Google
quotes.text: Mark was knowledgeable and delivered the stories with passion and knowledge. We wish it was 3 hours not an hour and a half, because we were so entertained. The poem at the end, was icing on the cake. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Ericaq103 via TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Excellent and thorough. Gave great information about less likely discussed black history and it’s impact locally, regionally. The best tour of Charleston I have ever been on.

quotes.author: Emma P. via TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Our tour guide Mark was fantastic! He was super personable and knowledgeable! The tour is very thorough. Would highly recommend this tour!
